newsitem.title: INDIA: British team to indentify India air crash victims.
newsitem.headline: British team to indentify India air crash victims.

text.p: Saudi Arabian Airlines said on Tuesday it had brought in a team of forensic experts from Britain to help identify the bodies of victims of the world's deadliest mid-air collision.
Indian officials said on Monday they had recovered the bodies of all 312 people on board the Saudi Airlines Boeing 747, which crashed after colliding with a Kazakh cargo plane on November 12.
Officials said 58 were as yet unidentified.
The bodies of all 37 people from the Kazakh Ilyushin Il-76 freighter were found shortly after the accident.
The team consists of specialists from the British Academy of Forensic Sciences who have handled indentifications in more than 30 air crashes worlwide, the airline said.
